title: The Fkh Web Client
summary: Fkh Web Client is a web-based interface that allows developers to manage Kubernetes containers and clusters from a phone without requiring VS Code or CLI installation. It uses GitHub authentication and centralized backend logic, making it simple and secure for performing quick operational tasks.
key_points: Web client provides a lightweight interface for starting, stopping containers, and managing the entire Fkh cluster from mobile devices
Uses the same GitHub authentication and group membership as other Fkh interfaces, eliminating separate account management
All business logic resides in the backend; the web client only handles display and API calls for a simple, maintainable architecture
Designed for consultants and code reviewers who need to perform tasks in test environments without installing development tools

quotes.text: You can perform some tasks in Fkh right from your phone - without opening a laptop, without a terminal, without VS Code.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical convenience advantage of having a mobile interface for quick operational tasks
